mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) AND tenant_id <> 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT h.id AS hostId, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(ai.assetCount, 0) AS assetCount, COALESCE(br.passCount, 0) AS baselinePassCount, COALESCE(br.failCount, 0) AS baselineFailCount, COALESCE(br.errorCount, 0) AS baselineErrorCount, COALESCE(vr.criticalCount, 0) AS criticalVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.highCount, 0) AS highVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.mediumCount, 0) AS mediumVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.lowCount, 0) AS lowVulnCount, COALESCE(pr.patchRiskCount, 0) AS patchRiskCount, COALESCE(sa.alertCount, 0) AS alertCount, GREATEST( COALESCE(br.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(vr.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(pr.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(sa.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(h.updated_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ) AS latestActivityTime FROM hosts h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS assetCount FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id ) ai ON ai.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 END) AS passCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) AS failCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS errorCount, MAX(scan_time) AS latestTime FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY host_id ) br ON br.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS lowCount, MAX(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at)) AS latestTime FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 GROUP BY host_id ) vr ON vr.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS patchRiskCount, MAX(scan_time) AS latestTime FROM host_patch_risk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'open' GROUP BY host_id ) pr ON pr.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS alertCount, MAX(event_time) AS latestTime FROM security_alerts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('new', 'acked') GROUP BY host_id ) sa ON sa.host_id = h.id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY latestActivityTime DESC, h.id ASC

COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS lowCount, MAX(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at)) AS latestTime FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id <> 0 AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 GROUP BY tenant_id ) vr ON vr.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(1) AS patchRiskCount, MAX(scan_time) AS latestTime FROM host_patch_risk WHERE tenant_id <> 0 AND status = 'open' GROUP BY tenant_id ) pr ON pr.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(1) AS alertCount, MAX(event_time) AS latestTime FROM security_alerts WHERE tenant_id <> 0 AND status IN ('new', 'acked') GROUP BY tenant_id ) sa ON sa.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(1) AS riskyHostCount FROM ( SELECT h.tenant_id, h.id, LEAST( 100, COALESCE(vr.criticalCount, 0) * 22 + COALESCE(vr.highCount, 0) * 12 + COALESCE(vr.mediumCount, 0) * 6 + COALESCE(vr.lowCount, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(pr.patchRiskCount, 0) * 8 + COALESCE(sa.alertCount, 0) * 4 + COALESCE(br.failCount, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(br.errorCount, 0) * 5 ) AS riskScore FROM hosts h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS lowCount FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id <> 0 AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 GROUP BY host_id ) vr ON vr.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS patchRiskCount FROM host_patch_risk WHERE FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id <> 0 GROUP BY host_id ) br ON br.host_id = h.id WHERE h.tenant_id <> 0 ) hs2 WHERE hs2.riskScore > 0 GROUP BY tenant_id ) rh ON rh.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.id <> 0 AND COALESCE(hs.hostCount, 0) > 0 ORDER BY latestActivityTime DESC, t.id ASC

SELECT feed.sourceType AS sourceType, feed.level AS level, feed.title AS title, feed.hostName AS hostName, feed.ipv4 AS ipv4, feed.detail AS detail, feed.eventTime AS eventTime FROM ( SELECT 'LOG' AS sourceType, sa.level AS level, sa.alert_name AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(sa.description, '安全日志告警') AS detail, sa.event_time AS eventTime FROM security_alerts sa LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = sa.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE sa.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sa.status IN ('new', 'acked')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BASELINE' AS sourceType, CASE WHEN br.status = 'ERROR' THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END AS level, CONCAT('基线异常 · ', COALESCE(ru.rule_name, br.check_key, '检查项')) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, CONCAT('状态 ', br.status, '，实际值 ', COALESCE(br.actual_value, '-'), ' / 期望 ', COALESCE(br.expected_value, '-')) AS detail, br.scan_time AS eventTime FROM baseline_result br LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = br.rule_id LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = br.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE br.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND br.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') AND br.scan_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PATCH' AS sourceType, hpr.risk_level AS level, CONCAT('补丁风险 · ', hpr.risk_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(NULLIF(hpr.related_patch_id, ''), NULLIF(hpr.related_cve, ''), COALESCE(hpr.recommendation, '补丁状态需要关注')) AS detail, hpr.scan_time AS eventTime FROM host_patch_risk hpr LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hpr.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE hpr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.scan_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'VULN' AS sourceType, LOWER(hvr.severity) AS level, CONCAT('漏洞发现 · ', hvr.vuln_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, CONCAT(COALESCE(hvr.product_name, '未知产品'), CASE WHEN hvr.product_version IS NULL OR hvr.product_version = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', hvr.product_version) END) AS detail, COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at) AS eventTime FROM host_vuln_result hvr LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE hvr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hvr.status = 1 AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 ) feed ORDER BY feed.eventTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT feed.sourceType AS sourceType, feed.level AS level, feed.tenantName AS tenantName, feed.title AS title, feed.hostName AS hostName, feed.ipv4 AS ipv4, feed.detail AS detail, feed.eventTime AS eventTime FROM ( SELECT 'LOG' AS sourceType, sa.level AS level, t.name AS tenantName, sa.alert_name AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(sa.description, '安全日志告警') AS detail, sa.event_time AS eventTime FROM security_alerts sa LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = sa.host_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = sa.tenant_id WHERE sa.tenant_id <> 0 AND sa.status IN ('new', 'acked')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BASELINE' AS sourceType, CASE WHEN br.status = 'ERROR' THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END AS level, t.name AS tenantName, CONCAT('基线异常 · ', COALESCE(ru.rule_name, br.check_key, '检查项')) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, CONCAT('状态 ', br.status, '，实际值 ', COALESCE(br.actual_value, '-'), ' / 期望 ', COALESCE(br.expected_value, '-')) AS detail, br.scan_time AS eventTime FROM baseline_result br LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = br.rule_id LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = br.host_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = br.tenant_id WHERE br.tenant_id <> 0 AND br.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') AND br.scan_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PATCH' AS sourceType, hpr.risk_level AS level, t.name AS tenantName, CONCAT('补丁风险 · ', hpr.risk_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(NULLIF(hpr.related_patch_id, ''), NULLIF(hpr.related_cve, ''), COALESCE(hpr.recommendation, '补丁状态需要关注')) AS detail, hpr.scan_time AS eventTime FROM host_patch_risk hpr LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hpr.host_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = hpr.tenant_id WHERE hpr.tenant_id <> 0 AND hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.scan_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'VULN' AS sourceType, LOWER(hvr.severity) AS level, t.name AS tenantName, CONCAT('漏洞发现 · ', hvr.vuln_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, CONCAT(COALESCE(hvr.product_name, '未知产品'), CASE WHEN hvr.product_version IS NULL OR hvr.product_version = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', hvr.product_version) END) AS detail, COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at) AS eventTime FROM host_vuln_result hvr LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = hvr.tenant_id WHERE hvr.tenant_id <> 0 AND hvr.status = 1 AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 ) feed ORDER BY feed.eventTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
